summary_markdown:
The session covered two main areas: facility calibration signal levels and demographic data for Finland.

**1. Signal Level Calibration:**
The participant requested the setting of a specific signal level (sl=84) for the Roadside category across five Finnish companies (7863, 7864, 7906, 7865, 7905), applying this to both Staging and Production environments. This task was completed.
Additionally, a separate signal level of 89 for the city category in Outshine was required, as it was an updated model standard.

The participant reviewed the data structure using a SQL query, confirming that the calibration should be based on existing facility records rather than just the presence of locations in all five companies.

**2. Demographic Data:**
The demographic integration for Finland (using Ramboll data) was confirmed to be proceeding correctly and is currently available on Staging, requiring approval and migration to Production. The initial setup had a minor issue regarding the inclusion of Ramboll data for "Media Audit Finland Oy," which was corrected.
Currently, only age and gender demographics are visible, as the front-end development is pending. The transfer of race demographic handling was assigned to another team member via a ticket system.
decisions: Signal level (sl=84) for Roadside category applied across five specified Finnish companies in both Staging and Production environments.
Signal level 89 set for the city category within Outshine.
Demographic data integration from Ramboll is confirmed to be ready on Staging, pending approval and migration to Production.
action_items: The demographic data transfer needs to be completed before a meeting scheduled for Monday.
Monitoring of the calibration status will continue; the participant may observe updates directly on Staging.
